name: u4ia
source:
You are heading to an exotic island (a large one with several cities/locations, not the beach and palms only type). While on this island you run into quite a few girls. You all have your own backstory to how you ended up there,
and there's a reason you're all there. u4ia tells the story of what's happening on that island,
the backstory to how you all got there, bonding with these people, getting ready for something you don't even know will happen. Try to befriend these girls and make the most of it. You will need it later on. And all the letters in the title is not only an abbreviation for Euphoria. They all have a meaning.
translation:
你将前往一个充满异国情调的岛屿（一个拥有多个城市/地点的大岛，而不是只有海滩和棕榈树的岛屿）。在这个岛上你会遇到很多女孩。你们都有自己的背景故事，知道自己是如何到达那里的，
你们都在那里是有原因的。u4ia讲述了那个岛上发生的事情，
讲述你们如何到达那里的背景故事，与这些人的联系，为你甚至不知道会发生的事情做好准备。尝试与这些女孩交朋友并充分利用它。稍后你将需要它。而且标题中的所有字母不仅仅是Euphoria的缩写。它们都有一个意义。
